name: google-ads-api-quickstart
description: Guides developers through Google Ads API quickstart: credential setup, choosing from 6 client libraries/REST, configuring environments, and running a "retrieve campaigns" script. Troubleshoots common setup errors: USER_PERMISSION_DENIED, login_customer_id issues, and DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED.  Use this skill when: - The user asks how to get started with the Google Ads API. - The user needs to set up Google Ads credentials or developer tokens. - The user wants to write a quickstart/example script for Google Ads. - The user encounters errors like USER_PERMISSION_DENIED or DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED.
